sections.introduction: Amrutadi Churna is a medicine which is in a powdered form. Amrutadi helps in treating Diabetes and other disorders related to it. Also, it helps in curing rheumatoid arthritis, morning stiffness of joints. The main ingredient of this formulation is Tinospora cordifolia.
sections.ingredients:
Giloy ( Tinospora cordifolia ) 
 Ginger ( Zingiber officinale ) 
 Gokshura ( Tribulus terrestris ) 
 Munditika ( Sphaeranthus indicus ) 
 Varuna Twak ( Crataeva nurvala ) 

 Method of Preparation 
 Firstly, clean all the ingredients. Grind all the ingredients separately into a fine powder and mix them well. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 It is poly herbal Ayurvedic powder formulation which is used for various chronic disorders like arthritis, rheumatism, diabetes and kidney stone. It has ability to balance the all three doshas (vata, pitta and kapha) in body. The herbs used in this formulation has properties like adaptogen, immune stimulant, antioxidant, anticancer and antidiabetic. Use of this medicine is very good for pre-diabetic and type-1 diabetic people to maintain normal blood sugar level. It is also beneficial in complications of diabetes such as neuritis. It cleanses bladder and use to treat bladder diseases like dysuria. It helps to reduce the heaviness of body and morning stiffness of joints. It also helps to improve the digestion and strengthen the digestive system. It helps to improve the appetite. Apart from these it is useful in insanity, tuberculosis, indigestion, bronchitis, spleen diseases, anemia, pain in the uterus and vagina, piles, asthma, leucoderma, dysentery, vomiting, urinary discharges, pain in the rectum, looseness of the breasts tissues etc.

fullContent:
Amrutadi Churna – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Sahasrayoga Churna Yoga Prakarna 
 Introduction 
 Amrutadi Churna is a medicine which is in a powdered form. Amrutadi helps in treating Diabetes and other disorders related to it. Also, it helps in curing rheumatoid arthritis, morning stiffness of joints. The main ingredient of this formulation is Tinospora cordifolia. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Giloy ( Tinospora cordifolia ) 
 Ginger ( Zingiber officinale ) 
 Gokshura ( Tribulus terrestris ) 
 Munditika ( Sphaeranthus indicus ) 
 Varuna Twak ( Crataeva nurvala ) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Firstly, clean all the ingredients. Grind all the ingredients separately into a fine powder and mix them well. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 It is poly herbal Ayurvedic powder formulation which is used for various chronic disorders like arthritis, rheumatism, diabetes and kidney stone. It has ability to balance the all three doshas (vata, pitta and kapha) in body. The herbs used in this formulation has properties like adaptogen, immune stimulant, antioxidant, anticancer and antidiabetic. Use of this medicine is very good for pre-diabetic and type-1 diabetic people to maintain normal blood sugar level. It is also beneficial in complications of diabetes such as neuritis. It cleanses bladder and use to treat bladder diseases like dysuria. It helps to reduce the heaviness of body and morning stiffness of joints. It also helps to improve the digestion and strengthen the digestive system. It helps to improve the appetite. Apart from these it is useful in insanity, tuberculosis, indigestion, bronchitis, spleen diseases, anemia, pain in the uterus and vagina, piles, asthma, leucoderma, dysentery, vomiting, urinary discharges, pain in the rectum, looseness of the breasts tissues etc. 
 Indications 
 
 Diabetes 
 Dysuria 
 Neuritis 
 Rheumatoid arthritis 
 Heaviness of body 
 Morning stiffness of joints 
 Acts as a bladder cleanse 
 
 Dosage 
 2.5 grams to 5 grams twice daily with lukewarm water before or after meals as directed by physicians. 
 Contraindications 
 
 If consumed in higher dosage, it may escalate the frequency of urination. 
 It should be taken under strict medical supervision. 
 Over dosage might lower blood sugar levels. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
